title: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
summary: A neutral-grip rope curl on a low cable for the brachialis, brachioradialis and biceps.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.7 for forearms (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Stand facing a low cable holding a rope with palms facing each other.
Curl up, keeping your elbows by your sides.

form_cues.cue: Curl the rope toward your shoulders
Don't let your elbows drift forward at the top.

mistakes.text: Leaning back to pull the rope up.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch.
Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Less constant tension.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Peak-contraction focus.
